• The word **"Resturant"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is "**Restaurant**".
 
• **Restaurant: **A place where people pay to sit and eat meals that are cooked and served on the premises. (रेस्तरां)
 
 
• **Example:** We decided to dine at an Italian **restaurant **last night.
 
 

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Refrain** (रोकना): To stop oneself from doing something.

 
 
• **Example:** Please **refrain **from smoking in this area.
 
 
 
• **Resemblance** (समानता): The state of resembling or being alike.
 
 
• **Example:** There is a striking **resemblance **between the two sisters.
 
 
 
• **Retain** (रखना): To continue to have something; keep possession of.
 
 
• **Example:** She managed to **retain **her composure despite the chaos.
